newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Bank Negara probes Pacific Bank shr deals.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Bank Negara probes Pacific Bank shr deals.

text.p: Malaysia's central bank is looking into dealings in the shares of Pacific Bank Bhd, Deputy Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said.
Anwar, who is also Finance Minister, confirmed late on Friday that an investigation was being carried out when asked to comment on a report in the Asian Wall Street Journal.

The regional business newspaper said on Friday the probe was related to unusually heavy trading of Pacific Bank's shares several days before the anouncement last May of a merger plan between the bank and Singapore's Oversea-Chinese Banking Corp Ltd (OCBC).
"Bank Negara is looking at it and will deal with it," Anwar was quoted by local newspapers as telling reporters after a dinner function.
The proposed Pacific-OCBC merger plan was dropped in January.
Officials at Bank Negara and Pacific Bank were not available for comment.
